//: Dated exceptions for scripts/check-npm-audit-allowlist.mjs (issue #297). Every entry MUST carry a real expiry date so an exception can't rot silently — the checker hard-fails on an expired entry even if the advisory is still unfixed, forcing a human to re-look and either renew (fresh justification + new date) or escalate. Re-run `npm view <pkg> versions` for a fresh in-range fix before renewing (see .claude/skills memory: npm-audit-redocly-overrides — 'no fix available' is usually wrong the first time you check, but confirm it's still wrong before renewing on autopilot).
